photo.label: Photo and suspension
photo.title: Start with a side photo of your bike
photo.description: Use a clear, level side-on photo with the bike at full extension. It may face either direction; avoid perspective or tilted shots.
photo.inputHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP. Maximum file size: 10 MB.
photo.rightsNotice: To publish your bike later, use a photo you took or have permission to share. Photos from other websites are only for private analysis.
photo.lowResolutionWarning: This image is smaller than {{minimumPixels}} px on its longest side. Use a larger photo if possible: small images make the marking less reliable.
photo.suspensionHelp: Choose the linkage shown in your side photo. Idlers, floating brakes and other layouts are not supported yet.

errors.invalidFormat: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image. SVG files cannot be used as photos.
errors.fileTooLarge: Choose an image smaller than {{maximumSize}} MB.

marking.title: Mark the key points
marking.description: Follow the guide and click the exact centre of each part on the photo.
marking.instructions: Click the exact centre of this point on the photo. You can select any point below to move it again.
marking.allPointsMarked: All points are set. Select any point below, then click the photo to move it.
marking.keyboardHint: Focus the photo with Tab. Use arrows to position a new point (half a pixel; Shift moves faster), then Enter to mark it. Select an existing point below to adjust it with arrows. Undo point removes its cross and coordinates immediately.
marking.canvasLabel: Bike photo used to mark suspension points

mainPivot.label: Main pivot
mainPivot.description: The centre of the pivot around which the swingarm rotates.

shockFrame.label: Frame-side shock mount
shockFrame.description: The centre of the shock mounting bolt fixed to the frame.

shockSwingarm.label: Swingarm-side shock mount
shockSwingarm.description: The centre of the shock mounting bolt attached to the swingarm.

horstPivot.label: Horst pivot
horstPivot.description: The pivot between the chainstay and seatstay, usually close to the rear axle.

rockerFramePivot.label: Rocker-frame pivot
rockerFramePivot.description: The fixed pivot where the rocker link turns on the frame.

rockerSeatstayPivot.label: Rocker-seatstay pivot
rockerSeatstayPivot.description: The centre where the rocker link connects to the seatstay.

shockRocker.label: Rocker-side shock mount
shockRocker.description: The centre of the shock mounting bolt attached to the rocker link.

yokeRockerPivot.label: Yoke-to-rocker pivot
yokeRockerPivot.description: The pivot where the shock extension turns relative to the rocker link.

shockYokeEye.label: Yoke-side shock eye
shockYokeEye.description: The physical shock mounting bolt on the yoke. Do not mark the yoke-to-rocker pivot here.

bottomBracket.label: Bottom bracket
bottomBracket.description: The centre of the crank axle.

rearAxle.label: Rear axle
rearAxle.description: The centre of the rear wheel axle.

frontAxle.label: Front axle
frontAxle.description: The centre of the front wheel axle.

calibration.invalidReference: The two shock mounts are in the same place. Go back and correct one of those marks.
calibration.highScaleWarning: This photo may be too small for reliable marks. A larger side photo would give a more trustworthy result.

wheels.label: Wheel setup
wheels.help: Choose your front and rear wheel sizes.

eyeToEye.label: Shock eye-to-eye
eyeToEye.help: Centre to centre between the shock mounting bolts.

shockStroke.label: Shock stroke
shockStroke.help: How far the shock compresses, in millimetres.

chainring.label: Front chainring teeth
chainring.help: Number of teeth on the front chainring.

sprocket.label: Largest cassette sprocket (teeth)
sprocket.help: Teeth on the biggest cog in your rear cassette.

declaredTravel.label: Rear wheel travel
declaredTravel.help: Rear suspension travel stated by the bike manufacturer.

sag.label: Sag
sag.help: Suspension compression under your riding weight, as a percentage.

errors.wheelConfiguration: Select the wheel setup fitted to this bike.

results.label: Results
results.title: Your kinematics results
results.description: The curves and their explanations will appear here.

charts.title: Your kinematics curves
charts.description: Read each curve with its units, inspect an exact value with the pointer, or check its start and end values below.
charts.referenceLimit: Estimates using nominal tyres and a reference rider position, not a personalized ride prediction or a laboratory measurement. External validation of kickback, anti-squat and anti-rise is still in progress. Direct-chain single pivots only.
charts.percentageSummary: Starts at {{start}}% and ends at {{end}}%. Dashed line: 100% reference, not a score.

antiSquat.title: Anti-squat — pedalling response
antiSquat.description: How drive forces counter the rear suspension's tendency to compress under acceleration in this reference model. This is not an efficiency percentage.

antiRise.title: Anti-rise — braking response
antiRise.description: How rear braking counters the suspension's tendency to extend as load shifts forwards. Assumes a brake fixed to the swingarm; higher is not automatically better.

leverage.title: Leverage ratio
leverage.description: How much wheel movement acts on the shock through the suspension travel.

kickback.title: Pedal kickback
kickback.description: Estimated pedal rotation from chain growth, chain wrap and wheel rollback with the drivetrain engaged. Actual feedback while riding also depends on speed and the freehub.

axle.title: Axle path
axle.description: Movement from the starting position (0, 0), with equal scales. Left is rearward, right is forward, and up is compression.
axle.summary: Starts at X {{startX}} mm, Y {{startY}} mm and ends at X {{endX}} mm, Y {{endY}} mm.
axle.highlight: Maximum rearward movement: {{rearward}} mm, at {{travel}}% of the travel.

travelCheck.withinTolerance: The calculated travel is {{calculated}} mm, close to the declared {{declared}} mm ({{deviation}}% difference).
travelCheck.outsideTolerance: The calculated travel is {{calculated}} mm while the declared travel is {{declared}} mm ({{deviation}}% difference). Review the marks and shock measurement before trusting this result.

saveAnalysis.ready: Your analysis and summary are ready in your bike’s profile.
